name: LibPng

source.verification: Official libpng release tarball (libpng.sourceforge.io, ANNOUNCE 'libpng 1.6.59 - September 28, 2026'), downloaded on 2026-11-24. The release has no signature or digest file, so the imported files were compared byte for byte with the GitHub tag v1.6.59 (pnggroup/libpng, tag object a543b51f2de2904f3436830394b1013782f7f9e6) source archive and are identical. Imported files are the read-side library sources and the headers (no write sources, tests, contrib, SIMD sources or build scripts), scripts/pnglibconf.h.prebuilt and LICENSE.

licenses.upstreamExpression: LICENSE (PNG Reference Library License version 2, with the older libpng license for versions up to 1.6.35)

notes: PNG decoder for FreeType colour bitmap glyphs (CBDT/sbix strikes) in the font backend (Docs/Design/Font/08-ThirdParty.ko.md section 8.1, decision FD9). FreeType's sfnt/pngshim.c is the only consumer.
pnglibconf.h is an added file based on scripts/pnglibconf.h.prebuilt (the upstream configuration for builds without the configure step) with writing and stdio turned off; Rocks.patch records it.
All architecture-specific SIMD paths are off (PNG_*_OPT=0): PNG is lossless so the output is the same, and the library builds from one source list on every platform.
zlib is the Core Zlib module (Z_SOLO, Z_PREFIX); libpng sets its own zalloc and zfree, so the missing zlib default allocator does not matter.

modifications.reason: Added file: the upstream prebuilt configuration scripts/pnglibconf.h.prebuilt under the name the library includes ("pnglibconf.h"), as the upstream build instructions say to do without the configure step, with the write side (PNG_WRITE_*, PNG_SIMPLIFIED_WRITE_*, PNG_CONVERT_tIME, PNG_SAVE_INT_32 whose png_save_uint_32 is write-only) and stdio (PNG_STDIO_SUPPORTED, PNG_CONSOLE_IO_SUPPORTED, which needs stdio) turned off: FreeType only decodes from memory, and those paths use CRT functions the engine warning rules reject (fopen, strerror, gmtime).
